title: What You'll Make: The Simon Game
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Introduces the boss-level project: a browser version of the Simon memory game built with jQuery plus earlier-module skills.

concepts.heading: How the game behaves
points: Press any key to start; the game flashes one coloured tile and the player must click it.
Each level adds one more tile to the sequence, so the player has to remember and repeat a longer pattern every round.
A wrong click ends the game with a failure message, and pressing any key restarts from level one.
The challenge tests jQuery from the previous section plus JavaScript from earlier modules (arrays, functions, conditionals, timing).

concepts.heading: What comes next
points: The following lessons supply instructions and starter files, then walk through the challenge in numbered steps, each with an answer lecture.

task.name: Simon Game (overview)
task.starting_point: Starter files are provided in the next lessons (index.html, styles.css, sounds folder).
task.goal: Build a working Simon game: keypress to start, growing random sequence shown with animation and sound, user clicks checked against it, game over and restart.
steps: Work through Steps 1-9 in order, checking each answer lecture afterwards.
task.expected_result: A playable Simon game that increases in level each round and resets on a wrong click.
